notes: Activity and Pattern facets dropped after v2/v2.1 both failed silhouette validation. See docs/adr/0004-drop-activity-pattern-facets.md.

matter.description: What technical subject the record is about. Each record gets 1-2 matter tags.

tags.name: llm_agent_runtime
tags.definition: LLM API calls (DashScope, OpenAI, Anthropic), prompt template management, model output parsing (JSON / structured output), agent tool invocation, token streaming, embedding generation. Covers chat model behavior, tool calling protocols, and any DashScope/OpenAI/Anthropic SDK usage. Boundary: not about LangGraph orchestration (use langgraph_state) — about the model and SDK layer.

tags.name: langgraph_state
tags.definition: LangGraph StateGraph topology, nodes/edges definitions, state schema (TypedDict / Pydantic), reducers, checkpointers (MemorySaver / SqliteSaver), thread_id management, interrupt/Command HITL. Covers StateGraph quirks, state field merging rules, and graph compilation. Boundary: not about the LLM model itself (use llm_agent_runtime).

tags.name: persistence_db
tags.definition: Persistence-layer and database operations: SQLite/relational schema design, migrations (column add/drop/rename), INSERT/SELECT statements, transaction boundaries, DEFAULT handling, index design. Covers KnowledgeStore, sqlite3 module, schema evolution and on-disk storage. Boundary: not about in-memory state (use langgraph_state) or file-based config (use config_env).

tags.name: filesystem_path
tags.definition: File and directory operations: path manipulation (pathlib, os.path), file existence/permission checks, symlinks vs hardlinks, glob patterns, directory traversal, atomic writes. Boundary: not about file content semantics like JSON parsing (use json_serialization).

tags.name: git_vcs
tags.definition: Git operations: commit, branch, merge (fast-forward / no-ff), rebase, stash, diff, status, gitignore semantics, pull request workflow, conventional commit conventions. Boundary: not about CI/CD pipelines on top of git (use build_deployment).

tags.name: testing_framework
tags.definition: Test framework specifics: pytest/unittest test discovery, fixture lifecycle, mocking patterns, assertion APIs, test isolation, integration test setup, coverage tools, FakeEmbeddings / test doubles. Boundary: not about the act of writing tests (use Activity:testing); this is the technical object being used.

tags.name: http_api
tags.definition: HTTP request/response handling: REST endpoints, status codes (200/401/403/404), middleware execution order, authentication headers, FastAPI/Starlette/Flask routing, request lifecycle. Boundary: not about CLI command interfaces (use cli_argv).

tags.name: async_concurrency
tags.definition: Async/await semantics: asyncio event loops, asyncio.to_thread, threading.Thread, locks, race conditions, async-sync bridging, ToolNode sync requirements. Covers thread-safety, concurrent execution, and async wrapper patterns. Boundary: not about LangGraph parallelism (use langgraph_state).

tags.name: cli_argv
tags.definition: Command-line interface design: argparse/typer/click setup, flag/subcommand structure, argv parsing, stdin/stdout/stderr handling, exit codes, shell escaping. Boundary: not about scripts as orchestration scaffolding (use Activity:configuring or deploying).

tags.name: frontend_browser
tags.definition: Browser automation and rendering: Playwright/CDP page lifecycle, DOM querying, JavaScript execution, cookie/session injection, WAF detection, frontend rendering performance. Boundary: not about HTTP-level concerns (use http_api).

tags.name: config_env
tags.definition: Configuration and environment management: environment variables, .env file loading (dotenv), config files (pyproject.toml, settings.py), API keys/secrets propagation, runtime config injection. Boundary: not about deployment automation (use build_deployment).

tags.name: package_dependency
tags.definition: Package manager and dependency operations: pip/uv/poetry/npm installation, virtualenv creation, version pinning, lock files (uv.lock), pyproject.toml manipulation, dependency conflict resolution. Boundary: not about runtime imports (use Activity:configuring if about setup).

tags.name: json_serialization
tags.definition: Structured data formats: JSON/YAML/TOML parsing and generation, Pydantic models, schema validation, dict-to-JSON conversion edge cases, serialization gotchas (datetime, None, NaN). Boundary: not about LLM output as JSON (use llm_agent_runtime).

tags.name: logging_observability
tags.definition: Log emission and visibility: structured logging (JSONL events), log levels, stack trace propagation, metrics emission, telemetry, alerting infrastructure, observability gaps. Boundary: not about debugging activity (use Activity:debugging) — this is the logging mechanism itself.

tags.name: datetime_handling
tags.definition: Date/time values: timezone handling (UTC, ISO 8601), date arithmetic, epoch conversion, date string parsing, time-partitioned data structures. Covers datetime module and timezone-aware comparisons. Boundary: focused on temporal correctness, not on scheduling (use Activity:deploying for cron).

tags.name: build_deployment
tags.definition: CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions workflows, Docker builds, Kubernetes deployments, release automation, deployment script orchestration. Boundary: not about local package management (use package_dependency).

lesson_type.description: The polarity/type of the lesson. Each record gets exactly 1 lesson_type. This is an enum field, not a tag facet.

values.name: anti_pattern
values.definition: What NOT to do. A mistake, fragile approach, or naive solution that causes failures. The record's tone is 'don't / avoid / never / breaks'. Examples: 'Mocking the DB hides migration failures', 'Hand-crafting plist XML is error-prone'.

values.name: discovery
values.definition: A surprising or non-obvious behavior of a tool, framework, or system. The lesson is the discovery itself, documenting how something actually works (often contrary to expectation). Examples: 'StateGraph silently drops unknown keys', 'fast-forward merge creates no commit'.

values.name: best_practice
values.definition: A recommended approach or correct way to handle X. The record's tone is 'should / prefer / use Y'. Examples: 'asyncio.to_thread for blocking IO', 'plistlib over string templating'.
